mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification(email, code_hash, expires_at, attempt_count, verified, updated_at) VALUES(#{email}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, 0, 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE code_hash = #{codeHash}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, attempt_count = 0, verified = 0, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, code_hash AS codeHash, expires_at AS expiresAt, attempt_count AS attemptCount, verified FROM email_verification WHERE email = #{email} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
